correctness.rationale: A circular active binary word has t positive zero and one runs, hence 2t<=n, with every integral 00 count A from 0 to n−2t realized by the explicit word 0^(A+1)1^(n−2t−A+1)(01)^(t−1). Constant cycles give only all-zero or all-one profiles. Adding integral intervals proves exact necessary/sufficient support. Setting all t_i>=1 when T>=r gives complete A-layer, while length-two strands show sharp failure at T=r−1. For two cycles, T=1 interval union has precisely the single equal-length hole and T>=2 is complete, giving S(N−S)+4−2 I_equal. Deterministic zero-error capacity follows by one codeword per attainable output. Actual finite exhaustive checker passed 64 ordered length pairs, 64 triples and 81 quadruples.

An implicit equivalent formulation remains possible.

value.rationale: The complete finite-length attainable profile spectrum for prescribed distinct circular strand lengths directly characterizes the observation states of a noiseless multi-strand read-multiset channel. The universal full-layer threshold is sharp uniformly in arbitrary number of strands, and the exact two-strand zero-error capacity features a genuine equal-length defect; this is an all-parameter constructive classification rather than a fixed numerical or textbook example.
